newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-STARS STEP OUT FOR EURO 6-A-SIDE TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STARS STEP OUT FOR EURO 6-A-SIDE TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Some of Europe's top players will show their skills in Ajax's state-of-the-art Arenastadium next week when four major clubs clash in a new six-a-side tournament, the first of its kind on the continent.
The four clubs -- AC Milan, Liverpool, Glasgow Rangers and Ajax Amsterdam -- are expected to wheel out their big guns on Monday and Tuesday to contest the "Euro 6ix's" competition.

Stars on show should include AC Milan's former World Players of the Year, Roberto Baggio and George Weah, Liverpool's Steve McManaman and Patrick Berger and Rangers' Paul Gascoigne. Hosts Ajax hope their front-man Patrick Kluivert, sidelined for much of the season, will back on top form.

The games will be played in four quarters of eight minutes each on a scaled-down version. Rolling substitutions are allowed throughout, but otherwise the rules are the same as in a normal 11-a-side match. It will be played as a round-robin with a final and third place playoff on Tuesday evening.

The organisers hope the frenetic pace of the six-a-side game will offer goals aplenty to invigorate an Amsterdam crowd still to get used to the new 51,000-seater ground and disappointed at the club's poor start to the season.
Each team is guaranteed an attendance fee of $200,000. The winner will get $400,000..
The tournament nearly failed to get off the ground after a spat, now resolved, between its sponsor Sony and rival Philips, a principal backer of the new stadium.
